title: GA/36/2013 of State Of Uttarakhand Vs Rajneesh @ Raju AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Application for Special Leave to Appeal No. 79 of 2013
With
Government Appeal No. 36 of 2013
With
Delay Condonation Application No. 1030 of 2013
State of Uttarakhand .............. Appellant

Rajneesh alias Raju and another .............. Respondents
{{{{
Present: Mr. V.P. Bahuguna, Brief Holder for the State/appellant.

Coram: Hon'ble Barin Ghosh, C.J.
 Hon'ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
BARIN GHOSH, C.J. (Oral)
 The learned counsel for the appellant seeks
permission to withdraw the appeal for removal of latent defects
with liberty to file a fresh one. Such liberty is granted.
 The appeal is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as
above.

(Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Barin Ghosh, C.J.)
 09.09.2013 09.09.2013
P. Singh
